label: MiniMax Code
description: One conversation with MiniMax Code, MiniMax's coding agent: three conversations are three nodes. Wire `agent` and `stream` into an AskAgent and talk to it in a Loop; end the loop with a CloseBus on `stream`, which ends this node's part of the run. With no `computer`, MiniMax Code runs on your machine (a local install only) from your own install of `mcode` with your own login, working in `folder`. If `mcode` is missing, weft installs it into a folder of its own, shared by the whole machine, before the node runs. With a `computer` wired, it is installed and run inside that computer, which a cloud install needs, and it logs in with the connection on `access`. When it asks you something with its question tool, it ends its turn to wait, so weft sends your answer on to it as a message of its own, in the same turn. Even in `ask` its own classifier runs plain commands without asking. With a connection, its data contribution is off. Its card shows what it is doing and a Start over button. What is exposed: the permission mode, the model, text added after its system prompt, and a system prompt to replace its own. Your program's tools reach MiniMax Code's model as `mcp__weft__<tool>`, and come back to your program under their plain names. MiniMax Code cannot let a program's tool take one of its own tools' places, so a tool named like one of them (`bash`, `read`, `edit` and the rest of this node's list) is refused when the program is built.

inputs.name: computer
inputs.description: A Computer to run MiniMax Code in. Left out, it runs on your machine, which only a local install has. Several agents may share one computer.

inputs.name: access
inputs.description: A MiniMaxCodeAccess's `access`: a MiniMax API key, or a model provider of your own. Required with a `computer`. Left out on your machine, MiniMax Code uses the login already on it (`mcode login`).

inputs.name: folder
inputs.label: Folder
inputs.description: The folder MiniMax Code works in. On your machine it is required, and must exist. In a computer it is a path inside the computer, its home folder when left out.

inputs.name: program
inputs.label: Program
inputs.description: On your machine: the MiniMax Code program to run, when it is not the `mcode` on your PATH or the one weft installs (an install of your own, a version you keep for this). A path on your machine, so it cannot go with a `computer`.

inputs.name: permission
inputs.label: Permissions
inputs.description: What MiniMax Code may do without asking. `ask`: what its classifier finds risky comes out of AskAgent as a question; plain commands run. `auto`: it decides on its own, and asks only what it escalates. `plan`: it researches and plans before making changes. `bypass`: nothing asks, nothing is refused; for a computer, which is the wall around it.

inputs.name: model
inputs.label: Model
inputs.description: As MiniMax lists it, such as `m:minimax:MiniMax-M3:v:thinking`. Left out, the login's default.

inputs.name: streamBy
inputs.label: Stream by
inputs.description: What goes out on `stream`: `message`, one event per whole message, tool use and result, so a run waiting on a long step sleeps; `token`, every piece of text as it is written too, which keeps the run awake while the agent writes.

inputs.name: appendSystemPrompt
inputs.label: Add to the system prompt
inputs.description: Text added after its own system prompt, for every turn.

inputs.name: systemPrompt
inputs.label: Replace the system prompt
inputs.description: A system prompt that replaces its own.

outputs.name: agent
outputs.description: The agent's handle: wire it into AskAgent's `agent`. Baked: made when the infra is started.

outputs.name: stream
outputs.description: Everything the agent does in this run, as AskAgent sends it. Wire it into every AskAgent of the loop, and into a CloseBus after the loop: the run's part of this node ends when it does.

then.message: MiniMaxCode '{id}' runs on the machine weft runs on, which a cloud install does not have; wire a Computer into `computer`.
MiniMaxCode '{id}' runs in a computer, where no login is waiting for it; give it a MiniMaxCodeAccess on `access`.
MiniMaxCode '{id}' works on your machine, so it needs a `folder` to work in.
MiniMaxCode '{id}' has a `permission` it does not know; pick one of ask, auto, plan, bypass.
MiniMaxCode '{id}' has a `streamBy` it does not know; pick message or token.
MiniMaxCode '{id}' runs in a computer, where `program`, a path on your machine, means nothing; leave `program` out, the computer installs MiniMax Code itself.
